findings.message: The token bucket row's window_end is set once at creation (now + 365 days), and later saves only update count/data/updated_at, so cleanup_expired() (window_end__lt=now) will delete a bucket that is still in use. A client hits a token-bucket-limited endpoint all year. 365 days after the row was created, cleanup_expired() deletes it because window_end was never moved forward. On the next request get_or_create recreates the bucket with initial_tokens, so a client that had drained the bucket instantly gets a full allowance again. Fix: add window_end to the saves (e.g. now + a TTL based on bucket_size/refill_rate) and include it in update_fields.
